I hope you have a day when someone makes you laugh so naturally that you forget, even for a moment, how serious everything has felt lately. May there be a conversation that brings back a familiar kind of happiness, perhaps with someone who knows your sense of humor without needing an explanation. Life can become so focused on responsibilities that we sometimes forget how valuable simple laughter is. I hope you experience the kind that makes your face relax, your shoulders loosen, and your heart feel a little younger. Keep those moments close, because they remind you that happiness does not always need a special occasion. Sometimes it arrives through a silly story, an unexpected joke, or a shared look between two people who understand each other. May your days contain more reasons to smile freely, and may you always have people around whom you never feel the need to pretend.
